-- Scenario 73b: SAP adds a column SEVERITY to the notification data product (additive change).
-- Expected guarded: L1 lists its columns, so nothing changes downstream; drift shows INFO "not adopted".
-- Unguarded: select * - see 75_observe.sql for what Snowflake actually did.
alter table {{DEMO_L0}}.PUBLISHER.MAINT_NOTIFICATION add column SEVERITY varchar;

insert into {{DEMO_L0}}.PUBLISHER.MAINT_NOTIFICATION
  (MAINTENANCENOTIFICATION, EQUIPMENT, NOTIFICATIONTYPE, PRIORITY, CREATEDON, DOWNTIMEHOURS, NOTIFICATIONTEXT, SEVERITY)
select 'N-' || lpad(2000 + n, 6, '0'), 'E-' || (1001 + mod(n, 10)), 'M2', '1',
       dateadd(day, n, '2026-10-05'::date), (4 + n / 2)::number(10,2), 'Breakdown - with severity ' || n, iff(mod(n, 2) = 0, 'HIGH', 'MEDIUM')
from (select row_number() over (order by seq4()) as n from table(generator(rowcount => 10)));

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('73b', 'SCENARIO_RUN', null, 'SAP added column MAINT_NOTIFICATION.SEVERITY and published 10 rows using it', 'PRESENTER');
